description: The Worthies, and ten minutes early

participation.context: Placed George, asked that Sam be kept out of the wind, and left at 10:50.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set Tom's entrance and released you ten minutes early.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Named the crush in the arras if Pompey does not clear.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Asked where he stands, and asked for no more Latin.
participation.name: George Bryan

participation.context: Mentioned. He was behind the tire-house door, out of the wind.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

participation.context: Mentioned. He had his cloak round Sam.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

relations.quote: It wants ten minutes of eleven, Will.

story.body: You settled George's place and went. Sam stayed cloaked with Augustine. You promised no new Latin for the roll.

relations.quote: It wants ten minutes of eleven, Will.

title: Placed George for the Worthies and went on to Paul's
